title: Staging dedicated SELECT-only backup policy reader and fail-closed preflight

phases.objective: Isolate Staging backup policy inventory from runtime_app by requiring one explicitly configured four-table SELECT-only reader, strict local environment identity, and no policy/approval/QA/Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: One-shot backup policy reader preflight using injected fixed local database identity
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A dedicated Staging table-scoped SELECT reader is accepted only with exact measured identity and narrow grants; unavailable readers and unauthorized identities are rejected without runtime_app fallback or execution authority.
steps: Require the exact Staging environment, runtime-db endpoint, expected source SHA and independent dedicated policy reader credentials.
Reject schema-wide SELECT, missing table grants and all write, administrative or cross-database privileges before attempting a policy census.
Verify live DATABASE() and CURRENT_USER() match the expected local schema and dedicated reader.
Fail closed with exit status 2 when the reader or an exact policy is unavailable, without performing a real backup, grant, restore, or QA fixture.
Preserve the existing P1 and P2 authority and backup executor regressions, and require separate live Staging certification before operational acceptance.
assertions: Runtime application credentials are never used as an implicit backup registry fallback.
Only the four approved backup metadata tables can be read under the dedicated identity.
No Production endpoint, approval activation, GRANT, database export, restore or QA principal mutation is performed.
Synthetic reader tests are not represented as real Staging backup/restore acceptance.
